name: Skeleton
summary: A loading placeholder: a group of stencil-coloured shapes in the layout the content will take, shimmering or pulsing until it arrives. Use it where content loads in place; a Spinner is for an action without a known shape and a ProgressBar for a measured wait.

inputs.name: children
inputs.description: The SkeletonItems, laid out by the caller in the shape of the content to come.

inputs.name: animation
inputs.description: wave slides a highlight across every item; pulse fades every item between full and 40% opacity.

inputs.name: appearance
inputs.description: opaque uses the stencil greys; translucent the alpha stencil, for coloured surfaces.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.description: An item's shape: a full-width rectangle of the size's height, or a circle or square of the size on both axes.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: An item's height, in px, and its width too for circle and square.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: An explicit width for a rectangle, overriding 100%.

anatomy.name: Skeleton
anatomy.description: The group: it carries the animation and appearance every item inherits and adds no visuals of its own (display block when rendered as a span).

anatomy.name: SkeletonItem
anatomy.description: One shape: a stencil-coloured box with hidden overflow and a pseudo-element covering it that carries the animation.

variants.description: The item is Stencil 1 and its overlay is a left-to-right gradient Stencil 1, Stencil 2 at 50%, Stencil 1 that starts translated -100% and slides to +100% over 3s on ease-in-out, forever.
The overlay is a solid Stencil 1 whose opacity runs 1, 0.4 at 50%, 1 over 1s on ease-in-out, forever.
The item is Stencil 1 Alpha and the wave gradient runs transparent, Stencil 1 Alpha at 50%, transparent; with pulse the item itself has no background and the overlay is Stencil 1 Alpha.
Width 100% (or the given width), the size as height, 4px corners.
The size on both axes, 4px corners.
The size on both axes with a 50% radius.

layout.text: An item is relatively positioned with overflow hidden; its overlay pseudo-element is absolutely positioned over the whole item (inset 0) and carries the animation, 3s ease-in-out infinite by default, 1s for pulse.
A rectangle is 100% wide with a 4px radius and the size as its height.
A square or circle is the size on both axes; a circle adds a 50% radius.

states.text: A skeleton is always loading: the wave overlay slides across every item, or every item pulses; under reduced motion the animation runs once in 0.01ms, leaving the rest colour.

behaviour.text: The wave overlay's transform runs from translate(-100%) to translate(100%) over 3s on ease-in-out and repeats forever; all items in a group animate in step when they mount together.
The pulse overlay's opacity runs 1, 0.4, 1 over 1s on ease-in-out, forever.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the animation duration is 0.01ms and it runs once.

semantics: the group is announced as a busy region with an aria-label such as Loading content; items are presentational

notes.text: The 3s and 1s periods, the ease-in-out curve, the 0.4 pulse floor, the 4px rectangle radius and the size steps are constants in the styles file; no token gives them, and the curve is CSS's ease-in-out, not a Fluent curve token.
Under forced colours the wave overlay's background is WindowText, so the shimmer stays visible over the system canvas.

The wave's gradient is 200% of the item's travel: it starts fully outside on the left and ends fully outside on the right, so a renderer without gradient paint draws slices of the Stencil 1 to Stencil 2 ramp and moves them across.
